RF Engineer Job at Infratel Africa




        
    

        
        Infratel Africa is a leading telecommunication infrastructure service provider in Nigeria and Sub-Saharan Africa. We provide RAN, backhaul and power as a service across Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: RF Engineer

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time

Role Overview
     

            
    




	The RF Engineer will be responsible for planning, optimizing, and maintaining radio access network performance across all technologies. 
	The role is responsible for RF design, capacity planning, KPI monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization to ensure reliable network performance while supporting new site rollouts and network expansion.
	The role requires strong analytical capability, hands-on experience with drive test tools, RF planning software, and the ability to collaborate with field teams to ensure excellent network quality.


Key Responsibilities
RF Planning:


	Perform RF planning for new site deployments and network expansions. 
	Conduct coverage and capacity analysis using planning tools. 
	Recommend site locations, radio planning and antenna configurations, 
	Produce RF design and coverage predictions. 
	Validate proposed sites for technical feasibility. 
	Support frequency planning and interference management. 


RF Optimization:


	Monitor daily network KPIs and identify performance degradation. 
	Analyze drive test logs and OSS performance statistics. 
	Optimize coverage, quality, accessibility, retainability, and throughput. 
	Investigate and resolve dropped calls, blocked calls, poor LTE throughput, and coverage holes. 
	Perform parameter optimization for GSM and LTE networks. 
	Recommend corrective actions to improve customer experience. 


Performance Monitoring:


	Monitor network health using OSS and NMS platforms. 
	Produce daily, weekly, and monthly KPI reports. 
	Track site availability and utilization. 
	Identify congestion and recommend capacity upgrades. 
	Monitor interference and spectrum utilization. 


New Site Acceptance:


	Participate in Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). 
	Verify RF performance before site integration. 
	Confirm coverage objectives have been achieved. 
	Validate antenna installation against design specifications. 


Network Expansion:


	Develop annual and quarterly RF expansion plans. 
	Recommend new sites based on traffic growth and coverage gaps. 
	Support Smart WiFi and rural broadband expansion initiatives. 
	Provide RF input during network modernization projects. 


Vendor Management:


	Work with all OEMs during optimization activities. 
	Review vendor optimization reports. 
	Verify implementation of recommended parameter changes. 


Documentation:


	Maintain RF design database. 
	Update frequency plans. 
	Prepare technical reports and executive summaries. 


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or related field. 
	3 to 7 years of experience in RF planning and optimization. 
	Experience with GSM and LTE networks. 
	Experience with rural network deployments is an advantage. 


Technical Skills:


	RF Planning 
	RF Optimization 
	Link Budget Analysis 
	Coverage Prediction 
	Frequency Planning 
	Drive Test Analysis 
	LTE KPI Analysis 
	GSM KPI Analysis 
	Interference Analysis 
	OSS Performance Monitoring 
	Spectrum Management 
	Antenna System Design 
	Propagation Modelling 
	Excel and reporting tools 


Proficiencies:


	All Network analysis tool e.g. Google Earth, Huawei M2000/U2020,Baicells OMC, VANU OSS, Excel, Power BI etc.


Competencies:


	Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. 
	Data driven decision making. 
	Ability to identify performance issues proactively. 
	Excellent technical reporting skills. 
	Effective stakeholder communication. 
	Planning and execution discipline. 
	Ability to manage multiple optimization activities simultaneously. 
	Continuous improvement mindset. 


Salary
N500,000 - N750,000 / Month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Human Resources Manager Job at Infytel Communications Limited




        
    

        
        Infytel Communications Limited is a growth-mindset tech company that provides leading-edge technology solutions and services to companies. At the core, our motivation is business growth for enterprise corporations, and in an age of pro-internet technologies, leading-edge technology is the most effective enabler for business growth and customer experience. We seek out, develop, and deploy tailor-made solutions either in-house or through strategic technology partnerships; and serve it to forward-thinking companies.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Human Resources Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a proactive and experienced Human Resources Manager to oversee the company's HR operations and support organizational growth through effective people management practices.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for recruitment, employee relations, performance management, policy implementation, and ensuring compliance with labor regulations.


Responsibilities


	Manage end-to-end recruitment and onboarding processes.
	Develop, implement, and enforce HR policies and procedures.
	Oversee employee relations, conflict resolution, and disciplinary processes.
	Coordinate performance management and employee appraisal activities.
	Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation.
	Ensure compliance with labor laws, company policies, and statutory requirements.
	Identify training needs and coordinate learning and development initiatives.
	Advise management on HR-related matters and workforce planning.
	Foster a positive work culture and drive employee engagement initiatives.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or a related field.
	4–6 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
	Strong understanding of Nigerian labor laws and HR best practices.
	Professional certification such as CIPM is an added advantage.
	Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
	Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and HR management systems.
	Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.


Preferred candidate


	Male candidate preferred.
	Must be willing to work fully onsite in Victoria Island, Lagos.
	Resides within reasonable commuting distance to Victoria Island or its environs.


Salary
